theorems.name: Submission.slicing_mb_density_majorant
theorems.statement: ∀ (ν : Measure ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ (∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ν (Icc (t - h) t) / ENNReal.ofReal h) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ g t) ∧ ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, g t ≤ ν (Ioo a b)
